accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.purpose: Reveal secondary detail inside the same object or process without changing view or route.

anatomy.rule: Groups related disclosure rows in one card-like surface.
Button row with title, optional icon, meta, and expanded state.
Shows disclosure direction and rotates with system motion.
Animates height and keeps collapsed content out of tab order.

variants.description: One open row at a time.
Rows expose count, status, or completion.
Rows use icons to reinforce section type.

Energy.decision: Use Design System semantic surfaces and action focus colors.
Energy.test: Verify contrast in open and closed rows.

Voice.decision: Use concise row titles and useful meta.
Voice.test: Verify titles do not become paragraphs.

Frame.decision: Use 56px triggers, stable padding, dividers, and content spacing.

Depth.decision: Use one grouped card surface, not nested cards.
Depth.rejectIf: Each row becomes a separate decorative card.

Momentum.decision: Use spring chevron rotation and height transition from Design System motion.
Momentum.rejectIf: Motion uses raw timing or wrong easing.

State.decision: Resolve disabled before open and focus.

Tone.decision: Use tone only in content or meta when risk is meaningful.
Tone.rejectIf: Warning color is used as styling.

Growth.decision: Escalate parallel views to Tabs and larger workspaces to Drawer.

Symbol.decision: Use chevron and optional section icons with accessible text.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizes and alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Chevron and leading icon align to row rhythm.

Accessibility.decision: Use button triggers, aria-expanded, keyboard toggle, and collapsed focus management.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard and screen-reader users understand disclosure.
Accessibility.test: Verify Enter, Space, aria-expanded, and tab order.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Triggers are divs or collapsed content is tabbable.

props.name: items
props.notes: Rows with title, content, id, and open state.

props.name: multiple
props.notes: Allows more than one open row.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.notes: Called when local expanded sections change.

props.name: density
props.notes: Disclosure density: sm, md, or lg.

do: Use meta for count or completion.
dont: Do not use as primary navigation.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: stacked disclosure with one open row
